historical_reviews.v3_1: A successful collection GET proves discovery only; the intended ComputerSystem member must be resolved and validated before its status can be judged.

original_test_intent: Read the intended Redfish ComputerSystem resource and validate its identity, power state, health/status and system type as a bounded read-only inventory/status check.
original_method: Use trusted curl/jq to GET the Systems collection, resolve the approved member link, GET that member once, and validate required non-null fields and types without changing state.
manual_activity: Provision the reusable secure Redfish credential/trust package and the approved target identity/schema policy; no per-run confirmation or manual hardware action is required after that configuration.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Approved Systems collection and target member selection policy
ComputerSystem schema and required Id/Name/PowerState/Status/SystemType rules
safety_requirements: Do not assume the literal member ID `system`
Reject redirects, null required fields and identity mismatch
Do not change power, reset, configuration, account or firmware state
agent_execution_scope: Resolve exactly one approved member link
Validate Id, Name, PowerState, Status and SystemType presence, types and allowed values

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: curl and jq are correct, but `/Systems/system` is an unsupported identity assumption, `-k` is unsafe and the filter does not fail on missing/null fields or validate HTTP status and schema.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With trusted TLS and secret-safe credentials, GET `/redfish/v1/Systems`, resolve the approved member from `Members`, GET its advertised `@odata.id`, require 2xx JSON and validate non-null Id/Name/PowerState/Status/SystemType types and allowed values before redacted export.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Systems read and 15/10 timing remain; no member ID or expected platform values are invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Implement a deterministic collection-to-member resolver and schema-aware field validator using the standard secure Redfish runner.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces hardcoded credentials, TLS bypass and guessed `/system` ID with certificate-bound discovery and explicit field validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Adds member identity and semantic validation while retaining the source's read-only System scope; it does not test power transitions or workload health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Multiple ComputerSystem members require an approved selection policy; status is a reported management-plane observation and not proof of physical or workload correctness.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK is equivalent if it preserves the Systems collection/member links, certificate and target identity, HTTP/schema evidence and required field validation. A fixed member name is acceptable only when explicitly configured and cross-checked against the advertised link.
expected_evidence: Immutable BMC and selected ComputerSystem identity
Systems collection response status and approved member link
Member response status/content type and redacted raw hash
Validated Id, Name, PowerState, Status and SystemType values/types

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, Systems collection path and read-only command consistently request System data. DeepSeek's fixed member ID and the generic clear-logs step are execution-quality defects, not competing Master identities or purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and resource family are explicit and can run after normal secure Redfish package configuration and target-member policy.

review_improvement: Converts a guessed member query into an advertised-link, certificate-bound ComputerSystem validation with non-null field and enum checks.
independent_technical_reasoning: Redfish member identifiers are implementation-defined, so `/Systems/system` may target nothing or the wrong resource even when the collection is valid. Automation must first bind the BMC identity, enumerate `Members`, select the configured target and then validate the returned member's identity and field types. jq output alone is insufficient because missing properties can become null without failing, and reported PowerState/Status are observations rather than proof of a completed transition.
